source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

mx.teacher_note: line of symmetry still holds here even though the figure is folded along the candidate line is missing from the stem — on the item about Decide whether a candidate line is a line of symmetry.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Fold test is what produces line of symmetry, so the usual direction of this relation is run backwards — on the item about Decide whether a candidate line is a line of symmetry.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: The line of symmetry rule also covers this: Do not require group-theory language, so it is not an exception — on the item about Decide whether a candidate line is a line of symmetry.

mx.name: operation_confusion
mx.teacher_note: Line of symmetry is found by multiplying the given values instead of dividing, giving 30 as the reported result — on the item about Decide whether a candidate line is a line of symmetry.

intelligence.enrichment: A line is a line of symmetry only when folding along it makes the two parts overlap exactly point for point.
